description_for_human: AI-powered HR assistant with interactive Workday forms, grievance intake, expense reports, and completion dashboards.
description_for_model: HR Concierge connects to an MCP server that provides interactive form widgets for Workday life events, grievance filings, expense reports, and HR policy lookups. Call get_workday_form for personal data changes, get_grievance_form for complaints, get_expense_form for expenses, and query_knowledge_base for policy questions.

functions.name: get_workday_form
functions.description: Shows an interactive Workday form for personal data changes (name change, marriage, beneficiary update, emergency contact, address). Use when an employee describes a life event or wants to update personal information.

functions.name: update_workday_employee
functions.description: Submits a personal data change to Workday HCM. Called from the Workday form widget after the employee fills in details.

functions.name: get_grievance_form
functions.description: Shows an interactive confidential grievance intake form. Use when an employee wants to file a workplace concern, complaint, or report an issue.

functions.name: create_grievance_case
functions.description: Submits a formal workplace grievance case. Called from the grievance form widget after employee completes intake.

functions.name: get_expense_form
functions.description: Shows an interactive expense report form. Use when an employee needs to submit expenses, reimbursement requests, or log business travel costs.

functions.name: submit_expense_report
functions.description: Submits expense line items for manager approval. Called from the expense form widget.

functions.name: show_completion_summary
functions.description: Shows a dashboard summarizing all workflow actions taken, completed items, and pending items.

functions.name: query_knowledge_base
functions.description: Search the HR policy knowledge base for answers about policies, benefits, leave, PTO, health insurance, code of conduct, grievance procedures.

functions.name: retrieve_policy_guidance
functions.description: Look up relevant HR policy articles from ServiceNow knowledge base.

functions.name: assess_risk_and_compliance
functions.description: Evaluate risk levels for each detected change and determine if approval is needed.

functions.name: build_impact_map
functions.description: Generate a dependency/impact map showing which downstream systems are affected by changes.

functions.name: execute_self_service_changes
functions.description: Execute low-risk self-service changes immediately (address, emergency contact, preferred name).

functions.name: structure_narrative
functions.description: Convert an unstructured employee narrative into a structured intake summary.

functions.name: submit_high_risk_changes
functions.description: Submit high-risk personal data changes (legal name, bank details) that require HR Operations approval.
